item.title: [Telugu] [Web Series] Varam
item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageTelugu
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date22 Oct 2026

Varam follows the story of a man living in poverty whose life is turned upside down when he is granted a mysterious boon. This new ability allows him to foresee tomorrow's news, which he uses to his advantage to accumulate wealth. However, this power comes at a price, leading him down a dangerous path where he must navigate the complexities of his new life and the consequences of his actions.
